target_pattern: Replace repeated nouns with direct and indirect object pronouns, keep IOP + DOP order, change le/les to se before lo/la/los/las, and place pronouns correctly with conjugated verbs, infinitives, and gerunds.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Keeping full nouns in every sentence or placing pronouns in English-like positions.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish sounds natural when you compress repeated objects into pronouns and follow a fixed stack: indirect first, direct second.
target_pattern_formula: placement: before conjugated verb or attached to infinitive/gerund
natural_examples: Veo a Marta cada dia. La veo cada dia.
Le di el informe a Juan. Se lo di.
Te voy a mandar el archivo. Te lo voy a mandar.
Estoy escribiendo la carta para ella. Se la estoy escribiendo.
Puedes pasarme la sal? Puedes pasarmela?

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as directed.
drills: Base: Le di el libro a Juan. -> replace objects with pronouns.
Base: Te voy a mandar la foto. -> move pronouns to attached infinitive position.
Base: Estoy escribiendo la carta para ella. -> rewrite with pronouns before the conjugated verb.
Base: Les explicamos las reglas. -> change to singular recipient ella and keep pronoun stack.
Base: Se lo dije. -> change direct object to feminine singular.
Base: Me prestaron el coche. -> change recipient to tu.
Base: Voy a mostrar el proyecto a mis jefes. -> replace with double pronouns.
Base: Puedes pasarme la cuenta? -> change recipient to nosotros.
Base: Se la enviaron. -> expand to full nouns: la invitacion to my grandparents.
Base: Te las traje. -> change direct object to singular masculine.
Base: Le estamos preparando la cena. -> move pronouns to attached gerund.
Base: Se lo voy a contar. -> make it negative in yo form with no voy a frame.
Base: Nos ofrecieron el contrato. -> change to recipient ellos.
Base: Le deje un mensaje. -> change tense to future with yo and keep pronouns.
Base: La estamos buscando. -> change direct object to plural feminine.

contrastive_discrimination.instructions: Choose the most natural pronoun form.
prompts: I gave it to her. (Le lo di. vs Se lo di.)
I am going to send it to you. (Te lo voy a enviar. vs Voy a te lo enviar.)
We are writing it for them. (Se la estamos escribiendo. vs Estamos se la escribiendo.)
Can you pass it to me? (Puedes pasarmelo? vs Puedes me lo pasar?)
They told it to us. (Nos lo dijeron. vs Lo nos dijeron.)
I explained it to him. (Se lo explique. vs Le lo explique.)
She is showing it to her clients. (Se lo esta mostrando. vs Esta mostrando se lo.)
We left it for you all. (Se lo dejamos. vs Les lo dejamos.)
I brought them to you. (Te las traje. vs Las te traje.)
I am reading it to her. (Se lo estoy leyendo. vs Estoy le lo leyendo.)

common_errors.why_it_happens: Learner stacks pronouns in English-like order.
Direct pronoun is placed before indirect pronoun.
Pronouns are inserted in a non-Spanish position.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Te lo voy a enviar / Voy a enviartelo.
Se la estoy escribiendo / Estoy escribiendosela.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Direct pronoun placed before indirect pronoun.
Question structure copied from English order.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Puedes pasarmelo? / Me lo puedes pasar?

common_errors.why_it_happens: Missing preposition a in infinitive frame.

common_errors.mistake: No voy a contarselo for direct negative command idea
common_errors.why_it_happens: Negation scope and verb frame are confused.

common_errors.mistake: Using full nouns every time after first mention
